name: Reeve
source:
He is the second son of MingFung, but was disowned because he refused to take over the Over Heaven society and left home.
He became good friends with Panther, and together they became popular burlesque dancers in NASA.
When Roast Pork took over the Over Heaven society after the deaths of MingFung and Jeff, he took over Roast Pork's restaurant and left NASA.
He brought Yvet to Roast Pork.
